summary: - **[key4hep/EDM4hep#528](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/528)** — `TrackerHit3D`, `TrackerHitPlane`, `SenseWireHit` and the `TrackerHit` interface gain a per-hit `timeError` member. The schema version is bumped and the previous schema is archived as `v6`, so producers and consumers of tracker hits can now carry timing uncertainties.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/124)** — Fixes the hit covariance orientation in `prepareTrackerHits`: the u/v uncertainties are now rotated into the ACTS surface frame instead of being assigned directly to loc0/loc1. In endcaps where the axes were swapped, good hits previously failed the CKF χ² cut, producing holes and truncated or lost forward tracks.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#125](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/125)** — Adds an `InitialTrackError_QOverP` property to `CKFTrackingAlg` and `GNNTrackFinder`, an absolute q/p error added in quadrature to the relative one. This lets the CKF correct poorly estimated high-pT seed momenta, especially in forward regions, without letting soft seeds drift into fake high-pT tracks.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1690](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1690)** — Sensitive detectors now keep volume-exit state changes when a short step is removed by the energy filter. Previously such hits stayed open into the next sensor, producing positions outside the sensor (e.g. stripes at z=0 between endcaps).

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1699](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1699)** — The calorimeter barrel and endcap surface plugins now support cylindrical surfaces (symmetry=0) in addition to polyhedra. This enables proper track extrapolation to cylindrical calorimeters such as the ALLEGRO ECAL.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#66](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/66)** — Fixes `EDMToHepMCConverter`, which set particle energy to the mass and divided vertex time by c instead of multiplying. Fixes `FlatSmearVertex` time offsets for events shifted along the beam.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#62](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/62)** — `HepMCToEDMConverter` now preserves particle ordering and includes vertex time. Feeding EDM4hep-converted events through ddsim now gives the same hit collections as the direct HepMC3 input path.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/113)** — `TrackMerger` gains a significance-based matching criterion and uses it by default. Matching defaults are aligned with `ClonesAndSplitTracksFinder` in CLDConfig, which changes merging behaviour for existing configurations.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#117](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/117)** — `VTXdigitizerDetailed` now reads sensor thickness from the sensitive volume rather than from the ZPlanarData/ZPetalData extensions. This makes the digitizer usable for compound vertex detectors such as ALLEGRO, while CLD results are unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#112](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/112)** — The GenFit track fitter now resets the global TGeoManager navigator to a canonical state before each fit. Without the reset, material lookups at geometry boundaries depended on previously fitted tracks, making results depend on processing order.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#116](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/116)** — `GGTFTrackFinder` gets an `EmbeddingCoordinates` property to support models trained with different embedding dimensions. It now tolerates extra model output features instead of crashing.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#403](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/403)** — The ALLEGRO digi+reco sequence can now run conformal tracking on silicon hits, enabled for ALLEGRO_o1_v03 and ALLEGRO_o2_v01. It relies on companion changes in k4Reco (keeping tracks without an ECAL intersection) and on new calorimeter surface plugins.
